abstract: Carboplatin was administered at 1,000 mg/m2/course in combination with etoposide at 300 mg/m2/course to 23 patients aged 5 months to 16 years. Five patients were affected by neuroblastoma, four by CNS tumors, three by Ewing's sarcoma, two by rhabdomyosarcoma, two by malignant teratoma, two by Wilms' tumor, two by head and neck carcinoma, one by hepatoblastoma, one by synovial sarcoma, and one by Langerhans-cell histiocytosis. Eleven patients were pretreated, seven of them with high-dose cisplatin. The overall response rate was 7/11 (64%) for pretreated and 10/12 (83%) for previously untreated patients. Myelosuppression was the main side effect, with anemia and thrombocytopenia more pronounced than leukopenia. Gastrointestinal toxicity and ototoxicity were very mild; nephrotoxicity and neurotoxicity other than hearing loss were not observed. In children with malignant tumors, the therapeutic activity of carboplatin at high doses, even in combination chemotherapy, deserves further studies.
abstract_ja: カルボプラチン1,000 mg/m2/コースをエトポシド300 mg/m2/コースと併用し、5か月から16歳の小児23例に投与した。患者は神経芽腫5例、中枢神経系腫瘍4例、ユーイング肉腫3例、横紋筋肉腫2例、悪性奇形腫2例、ウィルムス腫瘍2例、頭頸部癌2例、肝芽腫1例、滑膜肉腫1例、ランゲルハンス細胞組織球症1例であった。11例は前治療を受けており、そのうち7例は高用量シスプラチンを投与されていた。奏効率は前治療例で7/11（64%）、未治療例で10/12（83%）であった。骨髄抑制が主な副作用であり、貧血および血小板減少が白血球減少より顕著であった。消化管毒性と聴器毒性は非常に軽度であり、聴力障害以外の神経毒性および腎毒性は認められなかった。悪性腫瘍の小児では、併用化学療法においても高用量カルボプラチンの治療効果は更なる検討に値する。
